content: Alex lives in Musterstadt, rented flat on the second floor.
Alex works as a project lead at an engineering firm, Fridays from home.
Sam is Alex's partner, they live together.
Mia is Alex's sister and lives two hours away.
Alex runs three times a week in the morning before work.
Alex wants no appointments before 9 am.
Alex likes answers short, with the decision first.
Alex is on holiday in Lisbon from 3 to 10 May.
